plan.businessDomain: Recruitment pipeline: job positions opened by recruiters, candidates registered and their applications moved through screening, interview, offer, hired or rejected, with hiring managers deciding offer and hire on their own positions.

entities.title: Job Position
entities.description: An open role to fill, with title, department, description, headcount and its hiring manager. It closes automatically when hires reach the headcount; hires so far and applications by stage are derived from its applications.

entities.title: Application
entities.description: A candidate applying to a job position. It moves through screening, interview, offer, then hired or rejected; a rejection records its reason.

entities.title: Candidate
entities.description: A person who applies to job positions. Name lives in the master record, the e-mail is a linked contact channel, the resume is a platform attachment; the module namespace keeps only the candidate's source.

entities.title: Candidate E-mail
entities.description: The candidate's e-mail address as a contact channel record, linked to the candidate by HasContact and used to find duplicates.

entities.title: Hiring Manager
entities.description: The person responsible for a job position who decides offers and hires; the positions and applications they see are scoped to the positions that point at them.

relationships.description: Each job position has one hiring manager who decides offers and hires for it.
Each application is made to one job position.
Each application belongs to one candidate.
The candidate's e-mail addresses are contact channels linked to the candidate.
The candidates who applied to a job position, read through its applications.

entities.title: Job Position
entities.description: An open role to fill, with title, department, description, headcount and its hiring manager. It closes automatically when hires reach the headcount; hires so far and applications by stage are derived from its applications.

hiringManager.title: Hiring manager
hiringManager.description: Each job position has one hiring manager who decides offers and hires for it.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: Candidates who applied to this position, read through its applications.

capabilities.read.byId: Opens one job position by id for the recruiter's review and the hiring manager's position screen.
capabilities.locate.byColumn: Lists positions filtered by status, department or hiring manager and ordered by opening date, so the recruiter picks an open position and the hiring manager sees the ones they manage.
capabilities.locate.byText: Searches positions by title or department from the recruiter's search box when recording an application.
capabilities.count: Counts open or closed positions for list headers seen by recruiters and hiring managers.
capabilities.listByForeignKey: Lists the positions of one hiring manager by hiringManagerId, and fills the position of many applications at once.
capabilities.create: The recruiter opens a new position with title, department, description, headcount and hiring manager, starting open.
capabilities.update: The recruiter corrects title, department, description, headcount or hiring manager of a position.
capabilities.transition: The application pipeline moves the position from open to closed when its headcount is filled; no person does it.
capabilities.read.mdmRecord: Reads the hiring manager's master record behind hiringManagerId to show their name on the position.
capabilities.comment: Recruiters and hiring managers leave notes on a position.
capabilities.attach.document: The recruiter attaches a job description file or approval document to the position.

title.title: Title
title.description: Title of the job position, shown in lists and searched by recruiters and hiring managers.

department.title: Department
department.description: Department the position belongs to; recruiters filter and sort positions by it.

hiringManagerId.title: Hiring manager
hiringManagerId.description: The hiring manager of this position, who decides offers and hires; hiring managers list their own positions by it.

status.title: Status
status.description: Whether the position is open to applications or closed because its headcount was filled.

openedAt.title: Opened on
openedAt.description: Date the recruiter opened the position; lists are ordered by it.

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of the role, its responsibilities and requirements.

headcount.title: Headcount
headcount.description: Number of people to hire for this position; the position closes when hires reach it.

closedAt.title: Closed at
closedAt.description: When the position was closed automatically because its headcount was filled.

hiresSoFar.title: Hires so far
hiresSoFar.description: Number of applications to this position that are in the hired stage.

remainingOpenings.title: Remaining openings
remainingOpenings.description: Headcount of the position minus the applications already hired, never below zero.

applicationsByStage.title: Applications by stage
applicationsByStage.description: Count of this position's applications in each stage: screening, interview, offer, hired and rejected.

isFilled.title: Filled
isFilled.description: True when the applications hired for this position reach its headcount.

transitions.description: The application pipeline closes the position automatically when the number of hired applications reaches the headcount.

entities.title: Application
entities.description: A candidate applying to a job position. It moves through screening, interview, offer, then hired or rejected; a rejection records its reason.

jobPosition.title: Job position applied to
jobPosition.description: Each application is made to one job position.

candidate.title: Applying candidate
candidate.description: Each application belongs to one candidate.

capabilities.read.byId: Opens one application by its id when the recruiter or hiring manager follows a notification or a link from the pipeline.
capabilities.locate.byColumn: Lists applications filtered by position, candidate and stage, ordered by applied date, so the recruiter sees screening lists and the hiring manager sees interview and offer lists of their positions.
capabilities.locate.byText: Finds an application by typing part of its application number in the pipeline search box.
capabilities.count: Counts applications per stage of a position for the pipeline header and counts hires against the headcount.
capabilities.listByForeignKey: Lists all applications of a job position or of a candidate on their record screens, hydrating many at once.
capabilities.create: The recruiter records a new application of a candidate to an open position, starting in screening.
capabilities.update: The recruiter corrects the application details while it is still active.
capabilities.transition: Moves the stage column: the recruiter advances to interview and rejects with a reason, the position's hiring manager extends the offer and confirms the hire.
capabilities.uniqueKey: The engine refuses a second application with the same application number.
capabilities.transaction: Confirming a hire writes the application as hired and closes the job position in one all-or-nothing operation when the headcount is filled.
capabilities.read.mdmRecord: Reads the candidate master record behind each application to show name, e-mail, resume link and source to the recruiter and hiring manager.
capabilities.sequence.next: Issues the application number from the platform sequence hiringPipeline.Application when the recruiter records the application.
capabilities.comment: Recruiter and hiring manager leave notes on the application while discussing interviews and offers.
capabilities.statusHistory.read: Shows when the application changed stage and who moved it, reviewed before advancing, offering or rejecting.
capabilities.audit: Lets an administrator see who changed an application and when.

applicationNumber.title: Application number
applicationNumber.description: Number people quote for the application, issued by the platform number sequence when the application is recorded.

jobPositionId.title: Job position
jobPositionId.description: The job position the candidate applies to; used to list a position's pipeline.

candidateId.title: Candidate
candidateId.description: The candidate who applies; name, e-mail, resume link and source are read from the candidate record.

values.title: Screening
values.description: Recorded and being screened by the recruiter.

values.title: Interview
values.description: In interviews; the hiring manager decides on an offer.

values.title: Offer
values.description: An offer was extended to the candidate.

values.title: Hired
values.description: The candidate was hired; counts towards the position's headcount.

values.title: Rejected
values.description: The application was closed with a reason.

status.title: Stage
status.description: Current stage of the application in the hiring pipeline.

appliedAt.title: Applied on
appliedAt.description: Date the application was recorded; lists are ordered by it.

details.title: Application details
details.description: Everything about the application that nobody filters by.

interviewStartedAt.title: Moved to interview at
interviewStartedAt.description: When the recruiter moved the application from screening to interview.

offerExtendedAt.title: Offer extended at
offerExtendedAt.description: When the hiring manager moved the application to offer.

hiredAt.title: Hired at
hiredAt.description: When the hiring manager confirmed the hire.

rejection.title: Rejection
rejection.description: Filled when the application is rejected.

reason.title: Rejection reason
reason.description: Why the application will not move forward; required to reject.

rejectedAt.title: Rejected at
rejectedAt.description: When the application was moved to rejected.

stageAtRejection.title: Stage at rejection
stageAtRejection.description: The stage the application was in when it was rejected.

isActive.title: Active
isActive.description: True while the application is still in screening, interview or offer, that is, not yet hired nor rejected.

daysInPipeline.title: Days in pipeline
daysInPipeline.description: Days from the application date until today, or until the day it was hired or rejected.

transitions.description: The recruiter moves a screened application to interview, handing it to the position's hiring manager.
The position's hiring manager decides to extend an offer to the interviewed candidate.
The position's hiring manager confirms the hire; when hires reach the headcount the position closes automatically.
The application is closed with a reason; normally the recruiter records it, and the hiring manager may decline at interview instead of returning it.

entities.title: Candidate
entities.description: A person who applies to job positions. Name lives in the master record, the e-mail is a linked contact channel, the resume is a platform attachment; the module namespace keeps only the candidate's source.

applications.title: Applications
applications.description: The applications this candidate has made to job positions.

emails.title: E-mails
emails.description: The candidate's e-mail addresses, linked as contact channels (HasContact).

jobPositions.title: Positions applied to
jobPositions.description: The job positions this candidate applied to, read through their applications.

capabilities.read.byId: Reads the candidate by mdmId to show them on the application list and the application screen; used by recruiters and hiring managers.
capabilities.locate.byName: Finds candidates whose name contains the typed text, filtered to the hiringPipeline.Candidate role; used by the recruiter before registering and when recording an application.
capabilities.locate.byContact: Finds the candidate who owns a given e-mail address so the recruiter does not register the same person twice.
capabilities.locate.byDocument: Finds the person holding a national document, when the recruiter has one, to deduplicate before registering.
capabilities.register.createOrAttach: Registers the candidate: looks the person up, creates the master record only when absent, attaches the hiringPipeline.Candidate role and writes the source; used by the recruiter.
capabilities.edit.platformFields: Lets the recruiter correct the candidate's name, other names and privacy consent on the master record.
capabilities.edit.moduleNamespace: Lets the recruiter change the candidate's source in the hiringPipeline namespace.
capabilities.link.contact: Adds the candidate's e-mail as a ContactChannel linked by HasContact when the recruiter registers or updates the candidate.
capabilities.attach.document: Stores the candidate's resume (file or link) against the record under the resume category; uploaded by the recruiter and opened by recruiters and hiring managers.
capabilities.listLinks: Shows the candidate's linked e-mails and other relationships on the candidate screen for recruiters.
capabilities.inactivate: Takes a candidate out of use without deleting them, and reactivates them later; done by the recruiter.
capabilities.comment: Lets recruiters and hiring managers leave notes about the candidate.
capabilities.tag: Lets the recruiter label candidates with free tags (skills, talent pool) inside the hiringPipeline namespace.
capabilities.statusHistory.read: Shows recruiters when the candidate record was inactivated or reactivated, and by whom.
capabilities.audit: Tells an administrator who changed the candidate record and when.

status.title: Status
status.description: Platform status of the record; an inactive candidate is no longer offered when recording applications.

docType.title: Document type
docType.description: Type of national document, when the recruiter has it; used only to deduplicate.

docId.description: National document number of the candidate, when known; used only to deduplicate.
docId.title: Document number

countryCode.description: Country of the candidate (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); decides the privacy rules that apply.

createdAt.title: Registered at
createdAt.description: When the candidate record was created.

updatedAt.title: Updated at

aliases.description: Other names the candidate is known by, such as a nickname or maiden name, which help find them.

contacts.description: Summary of the candidate's linked contact channels; the candidate's e-mail appears here.

relationshipRefs.description: Compact keys the platform keeps for the candidate's links.

base.description: Platform base data of the candidate.

person.description: Platform person data; the hiring pipeline does not use any of it besides consent.

general.description: Fields promoted by the organization; read only in this module.

source.title: Source
source.description: Channel through which the candidate reached the organization, recorded by the recruiter at registration.

hiringPipeline.description: What the hiring pipeline knows about the candidate: only where the candidate came from.

entities.title: Candidate E-mail
entities.description: The candidate's e-mail address as a contact channel record, linked to the candidate by HasContact and used to find duplicates.

candidate.title: Candidate
candidate.description: The candidate who owns this e-mail address, linked by HasContact.

capabilities.read.byId: Reads the candidate's e-mail record by id so the candidate screen and application lists can show the address.
capabilities.locate.byContact: Finds the e-mail record holding a typed address so the recruiter detects an already registered candidate before creating a new one.
capabilities.register.createOrAttach: Creates the e-mail record when the address is new, or attaches the hiringPipeline.CandidateEmail role to the existing one, when the recruiter registers a candidate.
capabilities.edit.platformFields: Lets the recruiter correct a mistyped address or mark it verified.
capabilities.inactivate: Lets the recruiter take an address the candidate no longer uses out of service without deleting it, and reactivate it later.
capabilities.link: Links the e-mail to its candidate through HasContact when the recruiter registers or updates the candidate.
capabilities.unlink: Closes the HasContact link when the recruiter removes an address from a candidate, keeping its history.
capabilities.listLinks: Shows on the e-mail record which candidate it belongs to, for the recruiter and the hiring manager.
capabilities.audit: Shows an administrator who changed a candidate's e-mail and when.

jobPositions.title: Job positions managed
jobPositions.description: The job positions for which this person decides offers and hires; scopes what the hiring manager sees.

capabilities.read.byId: Reads the hiring manager by mdmId to show the name on job positions and applications; used by recruiters and hiring managers.
capabilities.locate.byName: Finds a hiring manager by typed name when a recruiter opens or edits a job position.
capabilities.locate.byContact: Finds the hiring manager behind a work e-mail before registering, so the same person is not created twice; used by the recruiter.
capabilities.locate.byLogin: Resolves the signed-in hiring manager from the login e-mail so the platform can scope positions and applications to the ones pointing at her.
capabilities.register.createOrAttach: Creates the person when absent, or attaches the hiringPipeline.HiringManager role to an existing person, when a recruiter assigns a hiring manager to a position.
capabilities.edit.platformFields: Corrects the hiring manager's name or other platform fields; used by the recruiter.
capabilities.inactivate: Takes a hiring manager out of use so new positions cannot be assigned to her, keeping past positions intact; used by the recruiter.
capabilities.link.contact: Adds the work e-mail or phone of the hiring manager as a ContactChannel linked by HasContact; used by the recruiter.
capabilities.listLinks: Shows the hiring manager's related records, such as contacts and reporting lines, on the record screen.
capabilities.invite.login: Gives the hiring manager a login so she can see and decide on the applications of her positions; triggered by the recruiter.
capabilities.comment: Leaves notes on the hiring manager record, such as availability for interviews; used by recruiters.
